name: kubedojo
description: KubeDojo — learn kind, k3d, docker, kubectl and Helm 2 by breaking a simulated cluster safely, then export it as a real setup script.

scripts.prepare:data: npm run engine && npm run content
scripts.build: npm run prepare:data && vite build && vite build --ssr src/entry-server.jsx --outDir dist-ssr && node scripts/prerender.mjs
scripts.build:single: npm run prepare:data && SINGLE_FILE=1 VITE_ROUTER=hash vite build --outDir dist-single
scripts.test: npm run prepare:data && node scripts/run-tests.mjs && node --test scripts/*.test.mjs
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm test && npm run build
